exposure: time between previous cesarean and present delivery
time between previous CS and present delivery
cohort: 150 pregnant women who were candidates for VBAC
finding: The VBAC success rate was 85.33%, and a longer interval between deliveries was associated with a higher success rate.
mod_finding: This study, examining vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC), found that VBAC success rates were higher when the interval between deliveries was longer.
